title: Password Policy Hardening
story: The organization has weak password policies. Students must configure stronger password requirements and account lockout mechanisms.

tasks.title: Edit PAM Configs
tasks.description: Open the PAM password configuration files used by the host.

tasks.title: Configure Password Complexity
tasks.description: Require stronger passwords using PAM quality controls.
tasks.hint: Configure pam_pwquality or an equivalent password quality module.

tasks.title: Set Password Expiration
tasks.description: Configure password aging rules so passwords expire on schedule.

tasks.title: Enable Account Lockout
tasks.description: Enable lockout after repeated failed authentication attempts.
